tasks.title: Implement config LRU cache in config.ts
tasks.description: Add inline LRU cache to readJsoncFile/loadConfig to eliminate repeated disk I/O and JSONC parsing. ~30-line change using Map + mtime checks.
tasks.details:
Create configCache Map<string, {doc, mtimeMs}> in src/config.ts. Wrap readJsoncFile with cache check: verify mtime unchanged via fs.stat, return cached if fresh. Invalidate on saveConfig/backupConfig writes. Set MAX_CACHE_SIZE=20, TTL via mtime check (no absolute TTL needed — mtime comparison handles staleness).

Files: src/config.ts (~30 lines added)
Tests: test/config.test.ts (add cache invalidation test)
Verification: bun test test/config.test.ts
Risk: Medium — stale reads possible if external process edits config. Mitigate with mtime check on every cache hit. Expected: 90-99% reduction in config load latency after first load.
tasks.testStrategy: New tests: cache hit (same mtime returns cached), cache miss (changed mtime re-reads), cache eviction (max size exceeded), write invalidation (saveConfig clears cache entry).

subtasks.title: Define configCache Map with mtime-based invalidation
Integrate cache into readJsoncFile/loadConfig
Invalidate cache on saveConfig and backupConfig writes

Run full config test suite

tasks.title: Parallelize findConfigFiles() with Promise.all
tasks.description: Replace sequential for loop in findConfigFiles() with Promise.all for concurrent filesystem scanning. Builds on config cache (Task 6).
tasks.details:
Current: for (const location of CONFIG_LOCATIONS) { ... await fs.lstat ... await fs.access ... } — 10 sequential I/O ops. Change to: const results = await Promise.all(CONFIG_LOCATIONS.map(loc => tryReadConfig(loc))). All 5 locations are independent. Sort results to maintain deterministic order.

tasks.testStrategy: Existing config discovery tests should pass — verify same files found (order may differ, sort in test assertions if needed). Add test for parallel execution correctness.
